_about: Settings of the sim server (harness/playground). A relative path is read against the harness folder; {uid} is this user's id and {cerulion_home} is CERULION_HOME, or ~/.cerulion when that is not set. data_dir keeps the history of ended episodes and, under episodes/, each episode's transcript and pictures. work_root holds each running episode's simulator files and sockets: keep it short. idle_reap: an episode with no call for longer than factor times the stated percentile of the gaps between calls is stopped, so a client that went away does not hold the simulator's memory; connect again for a new episode. lazy_records: before an episode starts, the robot body of its start state is checked for a calibration record on this machine; one that is missing is measured then, once (one to two minutes), and stored in body_records. macos_envhost: on macOS the simulator host starts through this script (Apple's OpenGL); elsewhere it renders with gl.

idle_reap.source: 72 model-driven episodes of this server on Linux x86-64, read 2026-11-18 from each episode's own record: a gap runs from the end of one tool call or resource read to the arrival of the next, with no call in flight; 2,386 gaps, median 5.85 s, 99th percentile 43.02 s (nearest rank), longest 104 s
